Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 33 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Shalini - 62 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vikram - 64 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Sunita - 26 years, friend
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vinod stands in the living room. Shalini, Vikram and Sunita stand near him.]

Shalini: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vinod laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Vinod: "Show me too!"

[Vinod jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Vinod: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
